<!-- generated by npm run docs:generate; do not edit -->

The shape `GET /v1/store/config` answers with, which is what a storefront renders its brand tokens, locales, direction and money format from. Every key is present; a value the store has not filled in yet is an empty string. The same shape, with a `fixture` block added, is a scenario fixture under `test/fixtures/store-configs/`.

## Fields

- `identity` (object, required).
  - `identity.storeName` (object, required).
    - `identity.storeName.default` (string, required).
  - `identity.brandName` (string, required).
  - `identity.description` (object, required).
    - `identity.description.default` (string, required).
  - `identity.legalName` (object, required).
    - `identity.legalName.default` (string, required).
  - `identity.contact` (object, required).
    - `identity.contact.email` (string, required).
    - `identity.contact.phone` (string, pattern `^$|^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$`, required).
  - `identity.address` (object, required).
    - `identity.address.street` (object, required).
      - `identity.address.street.default` (string, required).
    - `identity.address.locality` (string, required).
    - `identity.address.region` (string, required).
    - `identity.address.postalCode` (string or null, required).
    - `identity.address.country` (string, pattern `^$|^[A-Z]{2}$`, required).
  - `identity.areaServed` (array of string, pattern `^[A-Z]{2}$`, required).
  - `identity.businessType` (`"OnlineStore"`, `"LocalBusiness"`, `"Hybrid"`, required).
- `brand` (object, required).
  - `brand.baseColors` (object, required).
    - `brand.baseColors.primary` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$`, required).
    - `brand.baseColors.secondary` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` or null, required).
    - `brand.baseColors.accent` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` or null, required).
  - `brand.fontKit` (`"latin-rounded"`, `"arabic-latin"`, required).
  - `brand.logoAssetId` (string, uuid, pattern `^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$` or null, required).
  - `brand.faviconAssetId` (string, uuid, pattern `^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$` or null, required).
  - `brand.generatedPalette` (object, optional).
    - `brand.generatedPalette.tokens` (object, required).
    - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments` (array of objects, required). Each item:
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].token` (string, required).
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].reason` (`"contrast"`, `"no-accent-given"`, `"accent-from-secondary"`, required).
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].from` (string, required).
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].to` (string, required).
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].against` (string, optional).
      - `brand.generatedPalette.adjustments[].ratio` (number, optional).
- `localization` (object, required).
  - `localization.supportedLocales` (array of string, required).
  - `localization.defaultLocale` (string, required).
  - `localization.rtlLocales` (array of string, required).
  - `localization.timezone` (string, pattern `^[A-Za-z_]+\/[A-Za-z_]+(\/[A-Za-z_]+)?$|^UTC$`, required).
- `money` (object, required).
  - `money.currencyCode` (string, pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$`, required).
  - `money.symbol` (string, min length 1, required).
  - `money.symbolPosition` (`"before"`, `"after"`, required).
  - `money.decimalSeparator` (string, min length 1, max length 1, required).
  - `money.thousandsSeparator` (string, min length 1, max length 1, required).
  - `money.displayPrecision` (integer, min 0, max 3, required).
  - `money.taxDisplay` (`"HT"`, `"TTC"`, `"none"`, required).
  - `money.vatRate` (number, min 0, max 1, required).
- `domains` (object, required).
  - `domains.storefront` (string, pattern `^$|^https?:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]{2,5})?$`, required).
  - `domains.admin` (string, pattern `^$|^https?:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]{2,5})?$`, required).
  - `domains.api` (string, pattern `^$|^https?:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]{2,5})?$`, required).
